# perception

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:processPerception`](gmeow-processPerception.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/processPerception>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/mentation`](../../slices/mentation.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A perceptual episode — sensing and registering the environment (or an internal state) as it occurs. The occurrent that typically realizes a perceptual observation or claim.

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:MentalProcessType`](../classes/gmeow-MentalProcessType.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:processPerception`](gmeow-processPerception.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:MentalProcessType`](../classes/gmeow-MentalProcessType.md).
